project_type: FastAPI backend (Python 3.11+) with recommendation agent system, recently integrated RLHF system
build_system: backend: uvicorn + alembic migrations; frontend: Vite + tsc. No monorepo runner.
test_framework: pytest (pytest>=8.3 in requirements.txt). Frontend tests not configured.
build_command: frontend: cd frontend/web && npm run build | backend: no separate compile step; python -c 'from app.main import app' validates imports
verification_instructions: 1) Backend import check: cd backend && python -c 'from app.main import app; print("OK")'. 2) Run pytest: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v (tests must pass, no timeouts). 3) For agent modules: python -c 'from app.agents.recommendation_agent_v2 import RecommendationAgentV2; print("OK")'. 4) Check configuration: python -c 'from app.core.config import get_settings; s=get_settings(); print(s.llm_provider)'.
snapshot_or_generated_files: backend/app/ml/artifacts/*.pt (PyTorch checkpoints) — NOT committed. Alembic migration files in backend/alembic/versions/ ARE committed and must be written manually.
environment_constraints: Windows dev machine (PowerShell). Do NOT run alembic upgrade head (DB may not be reachable). Tests currently timeout after 120s — need to fix this first. RLHF system recently approved — minimal changes needed.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing SQLAlchemy patterns. Follow existing Pydantic v2 patterns. Migration files: manually written. All ML files: optional torch import with _TORCH_AVAILABLE guard. Maintain backward compatibility with existing recommendation API.
key_patterns: 1) RecommendationAgentV2: SFT+LLM+Weather pipeline, graceful degradation patterns. 2) AgentOrchestrator: coordinates multiple agents. 3) Settings: get_settings() returns pydantic Settings instance. 4) Error handling: try/except with logging and fallbacks. 5) Testing: pytest with monkeypatch for mocking. 6) Configuration: environment variables via pydantic-settings.
directory_structure: backend/app/agents/ — agent implementations; backend/app/services/ — service layer; backend/app/ml/ — ML models and training; backend/app/models/ — SQLAlchemy ORM models; backend/app/api/routes/ — FastAPI routers; backend/app/core/ — configuration and core utilities; backend/tests/ — test files; frontend/web/src/ — React frontend.
